bio.text: Michael J. Allen is the district attorney for Colorado's Fourth Judicial District (El Paso and Teller counties), a post he has held since 2021, and is the Republican Party candidate for attorney general in 2026.

According to his campaign website, he was elected district attorney in 2020 and re-elected in 2024, began in prosecution as a law-school intern in 2004, and has worked as a consumer protection prosecutor in the Kansas Attorney General's Office.
The site says he served eight years in the U.S. Navy as an Aviation Electronics Technician.
